findings.title: Drop targets whose expression becomes empty during interpolation
findings.body: The expression is filtered before `applyTemplateVariables`, but interpolation can legitimately resolve a variable-based expression to an empty string. Such a target remains in `queries` and is then classified and sent to Loki as an empty query instead of being treated like the existing empty-query filtering intends. Filter the mapped targets again (or interpolate before filtering on `expr`) so an empty variable value cannot produce an invalid backend request.

findings.title: Shard splitting can hang or throw for expressions emptied by interpolation
findings.body: This filters `query.expr` before template interpolation. If interpolation resolves an expression to an empty value, the empty target is passed into shard grouping and eventually delegated to `runSplitQuery`; that function filters the now-empty target out, produces an empty `requests` array, and `runSplitGroupedQueries` dereferences the nonexistent longest partition. Since this occurs from the async grouping continuation, the observable can remain unresolved with an unhandled exception. Interpolate first and discard targets whose resulting expression is empty, matching the prior shard path's effective ordering.
